nodes.description: Counters.Counter private _tokenIdTracker; monotonically tracks minted token ids in TheTriassicDread.
mapping(address=>uint256) presaleMap; per-address presale allowance written by addPresaleList and consumed in _purchase/batchPresale.
mapping(uint256=>uint256) attackMap; per-token attack value written in _purchase via _random and increased in upgrade (public).
mapping(address=>bool) operatorMap; privileged operator role flag set by constructor and setOperator, checked in upgrade.
bool public _mintStart; public mint gate toggled by owner through setMintStart and read by batchPurchase.
string public TOKEN_URI; base metadata URI assigned in constructor and by setBaseURI, read by _baseURI.
uint256 private nonce; incrementing entropy seed consumed by _random.
address private _owner (Ownable); privileged owner account read by owner()/onlyOwner and written by _setOwner.
constructor(string tokenURI): initializes ERC721 name/symbol, sets TOKEN_URI, calls _purchase() (mints token #1) and grants operator role to msg.sender.
batchPurchase(uint256 amount) external payable: public sale entry point; checks _mintStart, TOKEN_LIMIT, TOKEN_SUPPLY and msg.value, then loops _purchase().
batchPresale(uint256 amount) external payable: presale entry point; checks presaleMap[msg.sender], TOKEN_PRESALE, supply and payment, then loops _purchase().
_purchase() private: mints _tokenIdTracker.current()+1 to _msgSender(), assigns attackMap value from _random(9000)+1000, increments tracker and decrements caller presale allowance.
addPresaleList(address[] addrs) external onlyOwner: loops over input array writing presaleMap[addrs[i]] = TOKEN_PRESALE.
setMintStart(bool flag) external onlyOwner: toggles the public mint gate _mintStart.
withdraw() external onlyOwner: requires positive balance and transfers the whole contract balance to _msgSender() via payable transfer.
setBaseURI(string baseURI) external onlyOwner: overwrites TOKEN_URI metadata base.
setOperator(address addr) external onlyOwner: grants operator role in operatorMap.
upgrade(uint256 tokenId, uint256 add) external: requires operatorMap[msg.sender] then adds 'add' to attackMap[tokenId].
_random(uint256 randomSize_) private: increments nonce and derives a modulo value from block.difficulty, block.gaslimit, block.number, block.timestamp and tx.gasprice.
onlyOwner modifier (Ownable): require(owner() == _msgSender(), "Ownable: caller is not the owner") guarding privileged functions.
msg.sender / _msgSender(): attacker-controlled caller address used for minting, presale accounting, operator and owner checks.
block.timestamp: miner-controllable value consumed as entropy by _random.
payable(_msgSender()).transfer(address(this).balance) in withdraw: outbound ETH value transfer that hands control to the recipient (2300 gas stipend).
Pseudorandom number construction in _random using nonce plus block.difficulty/gaslimit/number/timestamp and tx.gasprice: predictable on-chain entropy.
attackMap[tokenId] += add in upgrade: unauthorized state mutation of token attack strength gated only by operatorMap.
amount parameter of batchPurchase(uint256 amount).
amount parameter of batchPresale(uint256 amount).
addrs parameter of addPresaleList(address[] addrs).
flag parameter of setMintStart(bool flag).
baseURI parameter of setBaseURI(string baseURI).
tokenId parameter of upgrade(uint256 tokenId, uint256 add).
add parameter of upgrade(uint256 tokenId, uint256 add).
addr parameter of setOperator(address addr).
randomSize_ parameter of _random(uint256 randomSize_); modulo bound.
loop counter i in batchPurchase for-loop.
loop counter i in batchPresale for-loop.
loop counter i in addPresaleList for-loop.

edges.reason: constructor uses _msgSender() to grant the initial operator role.
constructor calls _purchase() to mint the first token during deployment.
constructor writes operatorMap[_msgSender()] = true.
constructor assigns the tokenURI argument to TOKEN_URI.
batchPurchase forwards msg.sender into _purchase, which mints to and debits presale allowance of the caller.
batchPurchase reads _mintStart to gate the public sale.
batchPurchase loops amount times invoking _purchase().
batchPresale eligibility is derived from presaleMap[msg.sender], so caller identity controls the presale path.
batchPresale validates the caller allowance in presaleMap.
batchPresale loops amount times invoking _purchase().
_purchase reads _tokenIdTracker.current() and increments the tracker.
_purchase writes attackMap[tokenId] from the _random result.
_purchase decrements presaleMap[_msgSender()] when an allowance exists.
_purchase mints to and reads allowances for _msgSender().
_purchase calls _random(9000) to derive the token attack value.
_random increments and mixes the nonce state variable into the hash.
_random consumes block.timestamp as entropy, making the result miner-influenceable (timestamp dependency).
_random produces the modulo pseudo-random value that is used as token attack strength.
block.timestamp is one of the block-level inputs feeding the predictable randomness construction.
addPresaleList writes TOKEN_PRESALE into presaleMap for each provided address.
addPresaleList is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setMintStart writes the _mintStart sale gate.
setMintStart is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.

withdraw is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
the withdraw recipient is the caller _msgSender(), whose address receives the ETH value transfer.
value transfer hands control to the recipient code; Solidity transfer limits forwarding gas to 2300 so reentrancy is heavily constrained but the callback path exists.
setBaseURI overwrites TOKEN_URI.
setBaseURI is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setOperator grants operator role in operatorMap.
setOperator is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
upgrade authorizes the caller against operatorMap[_msgSender()].

upgrade mutates attackMap[tokenId].
the attackMap value is increased by the caller-supplied 'add' inside upgrade.

the onlyOwner modifier evaluates _msgSender() against the privileged owner account.

normalization_plan.reason: Caller-supplied mint quantity is only meaningful as part of the batchPurchase sale entry point.
Presale mint quantity is only meaningful inside batchPresale, which enforces TOKEN_PRESALE and payment.
The address array is an owner-only input consumed by the addPresaleList whitelist writer.
The boolean flag is immediately folded into the _mintStart gate by setMintStart.
The base URI string is directly stored into TOKEN_URI by setBaseURI.
The token id selects the attackMap slot written by the operator-gated upgrade function.
The add value is the arithmetic operand of attackMap[tokenId] += add, so it normalizes into the unsafe state mutation.
The address is written into operatorMap by setOperator and has no standalone semantics.
The modulo bound only exists to shape the PRNG output produced by _random.
Loop counter is a transient iterator of batchPurchase's _purchase loop and carries no independent state.
Loop counter is a transient iterator of batchPresale's _purchase loop and carries no independent state.
Loop counter merely indexes the addrs array while presaleMap is populated inside addPresaleList.
